principles: Themes are cosmetic and never select or reorder skills.
Each day balances reading/phonics, math, language/writing, discovery/logic, and off-screen movement or pencil work.
The app may substitute a due review or unlocked prerequisite when evidence shows the scheduled target is not yet appropriate.
Handwriting quality is practiced on screen and on paper; app tracing is not treated as a clinical or formal handwriting assessment.
Parents should favor regular short practice and read-aloud conversation over extending screen time when a session runs long.

weeks.title: Welcome to Learning Kingdom
weeks.goal: Build routines, listen carefully, name letters and quantities, and enjoy short successful practice.

weeks.title: Sound Detectives
weeks.goal: Hear first sounds, count objects accurately, and form familiar letters with a relaxed pencil grip.

weeks.title: Vowel Garden
weeks.goal: Notice short vowels, make numbers in more than one way, and put simple events in order.

weeks.title: Blend Bridge
weeks.goal: Blend and segment simple sounds, compose quantities, and begin building CVC words.

weeks.title: CVC Castle
weeks.goal: Read simple CVC words, join small groups, and retell beginning, middle and end.

weeks.title: Word Builder Workshop
weeks.goal: Encode CVC words, predict what happens next, and solve addition with objects.

weeks.title: Digraph Harbor
weeks.goal: Learn common digraphs, take away with objects, and explain simple causes and effects.

weeks.title: Blend Forest
weeks.goal: Read consonant blends, build simple sentences, and reason about space and plant growth.

weeks.title: Sentence Lanterns
weeks.goal: Read short sentences, strengthen number bonds, and learn new words in context.

weeks.title: Story Door
weeks.goal: Read decodable stories, identify what a story is mostly about, and use number partners.

weeks.title: Fluency Meadow
weeks.goal: Reread connected text smoothly, find missing number parts, and make simple inferences.

weeks.title: Long Vowel Magic
weeks.goal: Explore silent-e and long-vowel patterns while extending reasoning, story creation and coding sequences.

weeks.title: Mix, Review, Grow
weeks.goal: Consolidate earlier skills through spaced review and mixed practice without rushing ahead.

weeks.title: Shape Explorer
weeks.goal: Describe shapes and space, read for meaning, and use clues to infer what is not said directly.

weeks.title: Measure & Compare
weeks.goal: Compare length, height and capacity while discussing main ideas and observing real-world science.

weeks.title: Teen Number Towers
weeks.goal: Build teen numbers from a ten and ones, grow vocabulary, and practice connected reading.

weeks.title: Problem-Solving Palace
weeks.goal: Choose strategies for simple story problems and justify predictions with evidence.

weeks.title: Number Bond Champions
weeks.goal: See addition and subtraction as related parts and wholes while deepening reading comprehension.

weeks.title: Storyteller Studio
weeks.goal: Plan and tell a short story with order and details while keeping core math fluent and meaningful.

weeks.title: Discovery Lab Week
weeks.goal: Observe, predict and explain simple science while recording ideas with drawings, labels and words.

weeks.title: Puzzle Power Week
weeks.goal: Use patterns, spatial thinking, deduction and simple coding sequences to solve playful puzzles.

weeks.title: Read & Write Projects
weeks.goal: Combine reading, speaking, drawing and writing into small projects that have a clear audience and purpose.

weeks.title: Math Adventure Week
weeks.goal: Use objects, drawings and mental strategies to solve varied kindergarten math problems.

weeks.title: Kindergarten Review
weeks.goal: Review the full year-to-date path, concentrating on skills that evidence shows still need support.

weeks.title: Showcase Projects
weeks.goal: Create a simple showcase: read something, explain something, solve something and make something.

weeks.title: Celebration & Readiness
weeks.goal: Celebrate growth, collect a final sample of independent work, and choose the next six-week goals from evidence.
